# Record Finder

Find and read records. Use when someone asks for a record.

Made by Example Creator (https://example.org).

Files: openapi/records.yaml, scripts/lookup.py, references/guide.md.

## How to use

- Gemini: open Settings, then Skills, then Upload, and choose this ZIP file.
- Claude: open Settings, then Capabilities, then Skills, and upload this ZIP file.
- Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, or to edit it: open this ZIP file at https://code.depressioncenter.org/agentprise/

SKILL.md holds the instructions. LICENSE.txt holds the license.

## What changed in this export

- Record connector: needs setup. Works once the Example Records connector is turned on where you use it. The setup steps say how.
- Record server: needs setup. Works once the Example search server is connected where you use it.
- Record server: needs setup. Works once the Pinned tools server is connected where you use it.
- Record server: needs setup. Works once the Local helper server is connected where you use it.
- Record API: needs setup. Works only where an action for this API is connected.
- Record script: needs setup. The script comes with the skill. It works only where python3 can run and connect to the internet. On claude.ai, a workspace Owner must allow the address it calls.
- Record web search: needs setup. Works where the product can search the web.
